_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil resolves flat 100% of the time in recent windows; a directional guess repeats the analyst's documented 0-for-18 failure mode, so HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest call until the breaker reveals itself.
next_move.brains_agree: No—narrative implies imminent UP resolution; analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics and structural divergences
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d breaks above 60 with funding sustaining above 50 and mvrv_zscore climbing above 30
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 85 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d collapsing below 50 and funding flipping negative
